name: Today's focus
summary: Your three most important open tasks for today, and nothing else.
description:
A calm view of what matters most right now: the highest-importance tasks still open in Today, with their deadlines, plus how much of the day is done. Tick a task off right here, or add one and choose how important it is; both land in your To-do list.

Needs permission to read your tasks, add new ones and tick them off.
